more.def: Beside or very close to something, or showing who made something.
examples: The small cabin stands by the edge of the forest.
This painting was made by a girl in my class.
We went to school by bus.

easy.def: A word you say when you leave.

more.def: A short, friendly way of saying goodbye.
examples: Bye! I will see you at school on Monday.
Say bye to the ducks before we go.
